title: Cowboy on Horseback with Text Overlay
coreRelationships: The cowboy and horse are in motion, creating a strong diagonal line from lower left to upper right.
The bright red dust contrasts sharply with the blue sky and the white horse, drawing attention to the action.
The white text at the top provides a stark visual counterpoint to the vibrant, textured background.
The cowboy's gaze is directed forward, aligning with the horse's movement and the implied direction of the text.
reuseFormula: Recreate a high-energy western scene with a cowboy on a white horse kicking up red dust against a blue mountain backdrop. Overlay bold, white, all-caps geometric sans-serif text 'REALITY AWAITS' at the top.
